category_title: Students with autism displaying sensory-seeking vocalizations
minimal_context: Rick is working on an independent table activity with his 1:1 teaching assistant in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started on your independent table activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins doing the table activity and starts making humming noises.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please, Rick, stop with the noise, you're hurting my ears.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We will have to go to the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues making the noises to fulfill his intense sensory needs, despite the threat of exclusion.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's get started on your independent table activity.

STUDENT: (Begins doing the table activity and starts making humming noises.)

TUTOR: Please, Rick, stop with the noise, you're hurting my ears.

STUDENT: (Continues with the noises.)

TUTOR: We will have to go to the hallway.

STUDENT: (Continues making the noises to fulfill his intense sensory needs, despite the threat of exclusion.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When told 'Please, Rick, stop with the noise, you're hurting my ears' and 'We will have to go to the hallway'
